name: What should I consider before purchasing a bidet for installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before purchasing a bidet for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before purchasing a bidet, consider several key factors to ensure a smooth installation and satisfactory experience. First, measure your toilet bowl's shape (round or elongated) and dimensions to ensure proper bidet seat fit. Second, assess the availability of a GFCI-protected electrical outlet nearby if you plan for an electric bidet. Third, think about your water temperature preference and if you'll need a hot water line. Lastly, consider your budget and the complexity of the installation you're comfortable with; these elements influence both the bidet model suitable for your home and the overall project cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before buying a bidet, consider your toilet's shape, electrical outlet availability for powered models, hot water needs, and the overall installation complexity and budget.
